measured.basis: Each constant is 1.25 x the largest value measured over every overlapped generated-schedule run on the validated_for hosts (27 runs: on the M2 six early-completion and six late-completion runs, on the M4 Max nine and six; the latest three late runs on the M2 and two on the M4 Max evict while the load is held at its completion and release it after), rounded up to 1 MiB, so the envelope's own margin is 1.0. The prepare charge (generation_peak_bytes + 8 MiB + compile_peak_bytes, compile_peak_bytes 0) covers the prepare from the start of generation to the end of the compile (at most 242.6 MiB, M2). load_peak_bytes.all is the transient charged outside the VAE decode phase, so it covers every sample after a late run's eviction taken over the warmed ggml-only baseline, preparation leftovers included: at most 1097.4 MiB (M2; earlier late runs are bounded by their whole-run peak over that baseline; the M4 Max at most 797.0 MiB, 403.9 MiB where measured after the eviction), which also covers the load and warm-up over the footprint just before the load (at most 854.4 MiB, M2). The resident part (runtime_weight_bytes + 2 x I/O + workspace_bytes, runtime_weight_bytes being weight.bin's size) covers the steady state over the footprint just before the load, at most 854.1 MiB (M2), which holds the memory the warm-up prediction allocates for the program's GPU and CPU segments; the M4 Max stayed below each of these (prepare 242.4, load 555.3, steady 555.3 MiB). ane_compile_reserve_bytes covers ANECompilerService's absolute size while a load runs, 731.4 MiB on the M4 Max (its largest; the M2 466.6 MiB). No M4 Max run found the service clean (it held 373-454 MiB of other jobs' compiles before every load, and grew 0-329 MiB over that), and a service that already holds memory may reuse it, so its growth understates a cold compile on a clean service; the absolute size bounds it. On the M2 a load from a clean service (20 MiB) grew 104.0 MiB against at most 97.6 MiB from a dirty one.
